cause_quote: The introducing diff added `for (let offset = 0; sessions.length < limit; offset += 200)`, so denied meetings left the result count unchanged and the loop kept fetching full pages until the archive was exhausted.
user_saw: Listing meeting transcripts could take a long time when most or all stored meetings were inaccessible to the caller.
summary: The fix caps each transcript list call at 200 examined meetings and returns a continuation offset that advances past denied rows.
reasoning: PR #136679 introduced the agent tool’s list action with a limit on authorized results and no cap on the number of pages it could scan. I checked that the later read-worker change switched the end-of-archive check to `hasMore` and that the October refactor moved the existing loop into the tool module.
